title: Q3LOCK DLR source-window topology and limit-order audit
question: Does the manuscript source-window DLR construction use the correct KP topology, source normalization, quantifiers, and limit order, without silently importing a source-to-zero theorem from KP?
method: Read the manuscript tempered-DLR, source-window, compactness, kernel, and source-tangent sections line by line against the existing Q3LOCK DLR audit notes.
Check the primary KP statements for Assumption (A), Proposition 2.7, Lemma 2.8, Lemma 2.11, Lemma 4.1, Theorems 3.1--3.2, and the weighted projective topology.
Recompute the source convention, finite-M-before-Holder ordering, alpha_(k+1)<alpha_k tail direction, compact-boundary normalizer/lipschitz quotient, and the two-stage source-to-zero limit.
Separate fixed-source KP conclusions from Q3LOCK-local source-window and determining-class arguments, and retain the signed-review boundary.
finding: No new local algebraic or limit-order defect was found. The manuscript consistently uses exp(h*X_Delta) with the time integral inside X_Delta, proves finite one-site moments before Holder closure, uses the stronger slower-decaying alpha_(k+1) weight for projective tails, establishes a compact-boundary normalizer lower bound before quotienting, and keeps the order fixed-source periodic limit -> pressure tangent -> source-to-zero DLR extraction -> clipping/UI. KP Lemma 2.11 is not treated as a source-varying theorem; the source passage remains a Q3LOCK-local compact-boundary Feller argument.
decision_reason: The audit strengthens the DLR quantifier and topology boundary without promoting a theorem. Exact source-window constants, equivalence of the declared metric with the KP projective topology, finite form/trace hypotheses, and the bounded-continuous-to-Borel passage remain location-specific independent-review obligations.
boundary: T0 internal DLR source-window topology and limit-order audit; no claim-tier change, theorem certification, phase conclusion, sector closure, or PDF status change.
